title: 01_divergence_heatmap
interpretation: Peak relative divergence between engine and extraction, per observable and condition. The inflammation states (tissue integrity, blood pathogen) agree to well under 0.1% in both arms; the hemodynamic states carry all the divergence — small but nonzero at mild (the engine's fluctuation) and large at severe (the different decompensation mechanism and ~11 h lag).
